categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in automotive electronics and electrical components manufacturing. Main business segments include dynamic electronic control products (electronic throttle pedals, shift controllers, glow plugs, electronic throttle valves), body electronic control products (air conditioning controllers, interior rearview mirrors), and new energy system control products (vehicle controllers, integrated controllers, battery management systems). The company also has emerging businesses in photovoltaic energy (Aolian Photoenergy) and autonomous driving technology (Aolian Autonomous Driving).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses comprehensive in-house capabilities spanning the entire value chain from product design and development, mold design and machining, injection molding, SMT assembly, to final assembly and testing. Core technologies include electronic control systems, sensor integration, software development, and functional safety certification (ISO 26262 Level D). The company operates CNAS-accredited testing laboratories and maintains multiple customer-specific test centers (SGM GP-10 certified, BYD, JAC, SAIC-GM certified).
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are major Chinese automotive manufacturers including commercial vehicle makers (China National Heavy Duty Truck Group, FAW Jiefang, Sinotruk, Dongfeng Commercial Vehicle, North Benz Foton) and passenger vehicle manufacturers (Changan, Geely, BYD, GAC Aion, Xpeng, Li Auto, Nio). The company serves both traditional fuel vehicle and new energy vehicle markets, with growing exposure to EV manufacturers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China with manufacturing facilities in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province. Major operating regions include East China (44.88% of 2024 revenue), Northeast China (24.87%), South China (8.94%), North China (4.66%), Central China (6.16%), Southwest China (7.44%), and Northwest China (3.05%). The company has established subsidiaries in Hainan and maintains distribution across major automotive manufacturing hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the automotive supply chain. It functions as a Tier-1 supplier providing components directly to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and integrators. The company sources raw materials and components from upstream suppliers and delivers finished products to vehicle manufacturers for integration into final vehicles.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include: (1) deepening core automotive electronics business while tracking industry electrification, intelligentization, and lightweight trends; (2) accelerating new energy vehicle product development and customer expansion; (3) advancing functional safety capabilities and electromagnetic simulation; (4) developing next-generation platform products for cost reduction and quality improvement; (5) expanding into new product categories including autonomous driving components; (6) implementing cost reduction and efficiency improvement initiatives across operations.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of automotive electronic components to original equipment manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company uses both online settlement (for major OEMs) and non-online settlement (for other customers) methods. Revenue comes from product sales of electronic control systems, sensors, and integrated modules for both traditional and new energy vehicles.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with both domestic and international automotive electronics suppliers. As a specialized supplier of electronic control components, the company differentiates through deep customer relationships with major Chinese OEMs, comprehensive in-house manufacturing capabilities, and technical expertise in automotive electronics. The company holds a strong position in commercial vehicle electronics and is expanding presence in passenger vehicle and new energy vehicle segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized automotive electronics manufacturer with 2024 revenue of 440.16 million yuan, down 9.85% from 488.23 million yuan in 2023. Net loss attributable to parent company shareholders was 8.51 million yuan in 2024 compared to net income of 5.22 million yuan in 2023. Total assets were 899.51 million yuan at year-end 2024. The company has experienced revenue pressure due to industry competition, customer vehicle sales declines, and order delays, though maintains positive operating cash flow of 27.38 million yuan.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes: (1) comprehensive full-value-chain manufacturing capabilities enabling customized solutions; (2) strong technical expertise in automotive electronics with 187 patents and 73 software copyrights; (3) established relationships with major Chinese OEMs across commercial and passenger vehicle segments; (4) quality management systems and testing capabilities meeting stringent automotive standards; (5) cost competitiveness through integrated manufacturing and continuous improvement; (6) expanding capabilities in new energy vehicle electronics and autonomous driving technologies to address industry transformation.
